tools.name: recovery.clinical_decision.patient_fit
tools.description: Bounded patient-routing kernel for scope, fit, nonresponse, exercise, phase-aware return-to-sport review and escalation. Missing safety or clinical data returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA; causal claims, prescriptions and autonomous clearance are prohibited.

tools.name: recovery.clinical_decision.safety_screen
tools.description: Evaluate explicitly reported red-flag domains. Every domain must be PRESENT, ABSENT, UNKNOWN or NOT_APPLICABLE; omitted or unknown data can never pass the safety gate.

tools.name: recovery.clinical_reference.get_evidence
tools.description: Search Recovery TLV's published evidence bibliography. Returns citations and source identifiers without applying them to an individual patient.

tools.name: recovery.clinical_reference.get_healing_timeline
tools.description: Return broad educational tissue-healing phases and uncertainty. Does not generate a post-operative protocol, exercise dose or return date.

tools.name: recovery.clinical_reference.get_imaging_context
tools.description: Return population-level prevalence data only when the dataset contains the requested age cohort. Never extrapolates a neighboring cohort, interprets an individual's scan or excludes pathology.

tools.name: recovery.clinical_reference.get_outcome_measure
tools.description: Return educational information about published outcome measures and thresholds. Does not score or diagnose an individual patient.

tools.name: recovery.identity.get_clinic
tools.description: Return canonical Recovery TLV identity and clinician credentials. No clinical inference, pricing calculation or booking action.

tools.name: recovery.identity.get_location
tools.description: Return canonical address, coordinates, operating hours and contact channels. Hours are not live appointment availability.

tools.name: recovery.identity.get_pricing
tools.description: Return the canonical session fee, duration, cancellation policy and factual reimbursement status. Does not estimate unverified coverage.

tools.name: recovery.identity.get_scope
tools.description: Return the clinic's canonical inclusions, exclusions and minimum age as factual policy. Does not decide safety or patient suitability.

tools.name: recovery.navigation.get_booking_handoff
tools.description: Return human-confirmed booking and WhatsApp handoff links. Never claims to create, reserve, modify or cancel an appointment.

tools.name: recovery.navigation.get_condition
tools.description: Return a published condition record by exact slug. The record is educational and is not a patient-specific diagnosis or treatment plan.

tools.name: recovery.navigation.get_live_availability
tools.description: After applying the clinical routing and safety gate at https://recoverytlv.co.il/clinical/, return free_slots_snapshot: the available appointment times (only free times, never booked slots or patient data) from the list the clinic uploads about every 15 minutes (07:00-23:00 Israel time), filtered to

tools.name: recovery.navigation.get_reimbursement
tools.description: Return canonical health-fund reimbursement status and a calculation only where a verified cap exists. Unknown policy terms remain unknown.

tools.name: recovery.navigation.search_conditions
tools.description: Search the published condition index by text and language. A search match is content discovery, not diagnosis or confirmation that a patient is in scope.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "recovery.identity.get_clinic" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "recovery.navigation.get_live_availability" is 751 chars, far longer than this server's median (138). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: recovery.clinical_reference.get_healing_timeline · Private data: recovery.identity.get_clinic, recovery.identity.get_location, recovery.navigation.get_condition, recovery.navigation.get_live_availability · Public sink: recovery.clinical_reference.get_healing_timeline · Destructive: recovery.navigation.get_booking_handoff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: recovery.clinical_reference.get_healing_timeline · Private data: recovery.identity.get_clinic, recovery.identity.get_location, recovery.navigation.get_condition, recovery.navigation.get_live_availability · Public sink: recovery.clinical_reference.get_healing_timeline · Destructive: recovery.navigation.get_booking_handoff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
